expectedFix.explanation: Align lifecycle version across all modules

agent_response.rootCause: Conflict between two versions of androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-ktx: line 45 in app/build.gradle.kts specifies version 2.6.0 while another part of the project may be using version 2.5.0
fixGuidelines: 1. Open app/build.gradle.kts at line 45 to examine the conflicting dependencies.

2. Before:
```kotlin
app/build.gradle.kts:45: Module :app requires androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-ktx 2.6.0 and :core requires 2.5.0
After:
```kotlin
Ensure only one version of each dependency is specified in the build.gradle.kts file.
Perhaps update the required versions to a compatible pair or remove conflicting requirements.
3. Test by running ./gradlew build to see if the conflict is resolved after adjusting the versions.
